summary: Pilot formalization of Rooth-style alternative semantics applied to Greek additive/exclusive operators (ke, mono) vs English too/only: alternative sets as lists generated by substitution over a context entity list; asserted-content renderings of only (prejacent + all distinct alternatives false) and too (prejacent + some distinct true alternative); Greek variants gated by a boolean sisterhood flag; an axiomatized binary-sum mereology with DIST/COLL for single vs doubled ke (ke...ke forces distributivity); a reanalysis theorem deriving additive semantics when distributive ke hits a singular entity; a five-position toy syntax for the mono/ke movement asymmetry; worked John/Mary/Susan examples proved as iffs. 13 propositional axioms; AUDIT FINDING: the axiom set is jointly inconsistent (predicate_injective at a constant predicate contradicts john_neq_mary; False derived and Qed'd against the compiled .vo during this audit), so the example theorems that use predicate_injective hold only in an inconsistent context.

sources.citation: Rooth, M. (1985). Association with Focus. PhD dissertation, UMass Amherst.
Rooth, M. (1992). A theory of focus interpretation. Natural Language Semantics 1:75-116.

Unidentified analysis of Greek additive/exclusive operators ke and mono (sisterhood constraint, movement asymmetry, ke...ke distributivity) — the header names 'Greek ke/too' but cites no paper; no matching PDF under papers/.

definitions_mapped.coq: AlternativeSet A := list A; alt s focused := [s]; SemanticValue; pointwise_alt
definitions_mapped.source: Rooth's two-dimensional [[.]]o / [[.]]f focus semantic values with pointwise composition
definitions_mapped.note: alt returns the singleton [s] whether or not the item is focus-marked, so the focus dimension is degenerate; pointwise_alt and SemanticValue are defined but never used in any theorem — the two-dimensional architecture is not actually operative

definitions_mapped.coq: entity_alternatives / prop_alternatives (map P over context entities)
definitions_mapped.source: Rooth 1985 alternative generation by substitution in the focused position
definitions_mapped.note: restricted to entity-type foci drawn from a declared context list; ctx_contains_focus is taken as an Axiom though it is provable from the definition

definitions_mapped.coq: focus_interp C p := In p C
definitions_mapped.note: reduces the squiggle to bare list membership, dropping its presuppositions (C a subset of the focus value containing the ordinary value and at least one distinct element)

definitions_mapped.source: Rooth's association-with-focus 'only'; Greek mono with sisterhood constraint
definitions_mapped.note: prejacent asserted rather than presupposed; sisterhood is a boolean argument, not derived from the syntax module

definitions_mapped.source: additive too/also and Greek additive ke: prejacent plus a distinct true alternative
definitions_mapped.note: the additive presupposition is collapsed into asserted content, altering projection behavior

definitions_mapped.coq: SumEntity / atom / sum / sing + 6 axioms; DIST / COLL; ke_conjunction / ke_double
definitions_mapped.source: Link-style plural mereology for the collective/distributive ambiguity of single ke vs doubled ke...ke
definitions_mapped.note: binary sums only, fully axiomatized (no model constructed); no counterpart in Rooth — serves the Greek analysis

definitions_mapped.source: sisterhood and movement constraints distinguishing mono from ke
definitions_mapped.note: five-position toy syntax; the movement asymmetry theorem is true by definition of can_move

definitions_mapped.coq: Axiom predicate_injective : P e1 = P e2 -> e1 = e2
definitions_mapped.note: FALSE as an axiom schema: instantiating P at a constant predicate yields john = mary, contradicting Axiom john_neq_mary — the global axiom set is inconsistent (verified by compiling a Qed'd proof of False against the built .vo)
the sensitivity condition is incoherently stated (self-referential implication inside the existential) and the record is never instantiated

theorems.name: alternatives_contains_focus
theorems.source_claim: the alternative set contains the prejacent (Rooth: [[phi]]o is in [[phi]]f)
theorems.note: proved from Axiom ctx_contains_focus, which is itself provable from the definition

theorems.name: only_is_focus_sensitive / only_excludes_alternatives
theorems.source_claim: only excludes true distinct alternatives (Rooth 1985 association with focus)
theorems.note: the latter is trivial by unfolding

theorems.name: too_requires_alternatives / too_focus_sensitive
theorems.source_claim: additive operators require a distinct antecedent alternative; too is sensitive to the alternative set

theorems.name: ke_double_is_distributive / double_ke_both_tall
theorems.source_claim: doubled ke...ke forces the distributive reading (Greek analysis)
theorems.note: rests on the axiomatized sum mereology

theorems.name: ke_allows_collective
theorems.source_claim: single ke permits a collective reading
theorems.note: trivial: proved with the constant-False predicate

theorems.name: reanalysis_creates_additives
theorems.source_claim: distributive ke on a singular entity reanalyzes as additive (headline claim of the Greek analysis)
theorems.note: depends on predicate_injective, hence proved in an inconsistent axiom context

theorems.name: john_arrived_too_requires_other / only_john_excludes_others
theorems.source_claim: worked examples: 'John arrived too' iff John and another contextual entity arrived; 'Only John arrived' excludes Mary and Susan
theorems.note: depend on predicate_injective + example axioms — inconsistent context

theorems.name: additive_exclusive_incompatible
theorems.source_claim: too and only are jointly unsatisfiable over the same alternative set

theorems.name: greek_ke_requires_sisterhood
theorems.note: trivial: the false branch is literally False

theorems.name: alternatives_nonempty
theorems.note: false as stated — quantifies over ALL lists; countermodel: the empty list; the file's own comment concedes it belongs in a well-formedness condition

evidence: The operative alternative machinery (prop_alternatives by substitution over a context list) is a recognizable simplification of Rooth 1985, and the only/too meanings prove the expected exclusion/additivity interactions (additive_exclusive_incompatible, too_requires_alternatives).

The core two-dimensional architecture is changed to the point of vacuity: alt returns the singleton [s] regardless of focus marking, and pointwise_alt/SemanticValue are never used, so no theorem exercises Rooth's [[.]]f composition.
focus_interp renders the 1992 squiggle as bare list membership, dropping all of its presuppositional constraints.

AUDIT FINDING (this sweep): the 13 propositional axioms are jointly inconsistent — predicate_injective at the constant predicate (fun _ _ => True) yields john = mary against john_neq_mary; a Qed'd proof of False was compiled against the built extras/additive_new.vo. The three theorems using predicate_injective hold only in this inconsistent context.
The single Admitted theorem (alternatives_nonempty) is FALSE as written (countermodel: []).
simplifications: presuppositions of too/only/ke collapsed into asserted content
alternatives restricted to entity-type foci from a declared context list
binary sums only in the axiomatized mereology
sisterhood as a boolean argument rather than derived from the syntax module
omissions: genuine two-dimensional focus-value composition (defined but unused)
the squiggle's presuppositions and Rooth 1992's contrast/anaphora applications
focus phrase scope and multiple-focus phenomena
any model of the sum axioms (pure axiomatization)
additions: Link-style sum-entity axioms and DIST/COLL (no Rooth counterpart; serves the Greek ke analysis)
predicate_injective — a false axiom that makes the global context inconsistent
toy syntactic-position calculus for the mono/ke movement asymmetry

determination_rationale: Only a partial formalization exists: the Roothian core (focus semantic value, squiggle) is changed/degenerate, the presupposition dimension is re-founded as asserted content, and the headline Greek reanalysis claim plus both worked examples are established only via predicate_injective, an added axiom that makes the whole context inconsistent (False is derivable), so they are not established at all in the rubric's sense. The resistance shown is attributable to this pilot file's shortcuts, not to demonstrated resistance of alternative semantics itself — the file's own commentary and the structure of the proofs suggest a proper atlas-discipline rebuild (freshness-based alternative generation, presuppositions as definedness conditions, a constructed sum model) would likely reach determination 2 or better.

artifact_classes.description: no native presupposition dimension (additive/exclusive presuppositions collapsed into assertions); alternative sets as bare lists; Rooth's two-dimensional values have no substrate representation and the file's attempt (SemanticValue/pointwise_alt) is abandoned unused; plural mereology axiomatized rather than constructed
decidable equality on the abstract Entity type assumed via Parameter entity_eqb + Axiom entity_eqb_spec, required by list-based alternative generation (filter on negb entity_eqb)

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (13 propositional Axioms + 13 signature Parameters, one Admitted), and this audit additionally found the axiom set jointly inconsistent via predicate_injective.
